# Rahul Goel — Complete Architectural Portfolio & Technical Dossier

## Overview & Entity Identity
Rahul Goel is an Engineering Leader, Senior Engineering Manager, and Staff/Principal iOS Systems Architect located in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. Over a 13+ year career, he has led mobile engineering teams and designed core client platform architectures across leading consumer technology companies in India and globally.

## Core Architectural Competencies
- **Languages**: Swift (Expert), Objective-C, Python, TypeScript
- **Concurrency & Multithreading**: Swift 5.9+ Concurrency, Actors, Global Actors, TaskGroups, AsyncSequence, Structured Concurrency, Memory Barriers, Thread Sanitizer, RunLoop Optimization
- **Client Architecture**: Clean Architecture, VIPER, MVVM-C, Modular Frameworks, Dynamic Component Registries, Server-Driven UI (SDUI), Dependency Injection, Protocol-Oriented Programming
- **Media & Streaming**: AVFoundation, AVPlayer, CoreMedia, HLS (HTTP Live Streaming), DASH, Adaptive Bitrate (ABR) switching, FairPlay Streaming (DRM), Low-Latency HLS (LL-HLS), Shaka/MP4 demuxing, Hardware-Accelerated HEVC/H.265 decoding
- **Data Persistence & Sync**: SQLite with WAL (Write-Ahead Logging), CoreData, SwiftData, Realm, Conflict-Free Replicated Data Types (CRDTs), Delta-Sync algorithms, Offline-First state machines
- **Security & Integrity**: Apple App Attest, DeviceCheck, Secure Enclave, Hardware Key Derivation, SPKI TLS 1.3 Certificate Pinning, SQLCipher database encryption, Biometric Authentication (FaceID/TouchID)
- **AI Tooling & Agentic Workflows**: Model Context Protocol (MCP), Amazon Kiro, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, On-Device CoreML INT4 quantization, Local Vector Search (USearch/SQLite VSS), Autonomous code refactoring pipelines
- **Engineering Management**: 15+ engineer direct mentorship, 7-day canary release trains, modular interface graph governance, OKR planning, Sev-1 incident commander, hiring and performance management

## Scaled Consumer Platform Track Record
1. **SonyLiv (Culver Max Entertainment)**
   - Architected the iOS video streaming core for marquee live sporting tournaments including the Asia Cup.
   - Built sub-second adaptive stream fallback, dynamic mid-roll ad-insertion pipelines (SSAI), and memory-efficient player pooling.
   - Achieved 99.9% crash-free sessions across tens of millions of concurrent live streaming viewers.

2. **ShareChat & Moj (Mohalla Tech)**
   - Designed short-form infinite-scroll video feed prefetching engine.
   - Implemented 2-tier chunked segment caching and dynamic LRU storage management.
   - Reduced time-to-first-frame (TTFF) by 42% and delivered over $1,000,000 in annual CDN bandwidth savings.

3. **Paytm (One97 Communications)**
   - Engineered the high-velocity core Payments SDK integrated into the flagship consumer app.
   - Built a dual-signature HMAC-SHA256 offline transaction ledger supporting atomic retry queues under spotty cellular connectivity.
   - Processed over 100M+ transactions monthly with zero financial record loss.

4. **Myntra (Flipkart Group)**
   - Developed Server-Driven UI (SDUI) component engine enabling instant real-time homepage and catalog layout changes without App Store releases.
   - Engineered zero-downtime atomic session invalidation and token refresh pipelines sustaining 5M+ concurrent shoppers during the End of Reason Sale (EORS).

5. **Groupon**
   - Built the international Merchant Portal supporting real-time coupon validation, financial analytics, and inventory updates across 15 global markets.
   - Implemented background delta-sync with SQLite WAL concurrency for 500K+ worldwide merchants.

- Targeted Levels: Senior iOS Engineer, Staff iOS Engineer, Principal iOS Architect, Engineering Manager.
